name: mstack
description: MStack — a Claude Code plugin for academic research. Opinionated role-based slash commands that walk a paper from idea to archive. Inspired by gstack.

plugins.name: mstack
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin for academic research — 39 role-based slash commands across the full paper lifecycle (ideate, map, design, build, analyze, write, submit, reflect), a methods reference library (identification threats by design, estimation and robustness protocols, data pitfalls, preregistration and replication standards), and hook-enforced edit safety.
